featured_reviews.name: Bhumika Chandiramani
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is my second review for Harsha And Rakesh (Bungalows Plunge), and unfortunately, the experience has only worsened. During my first visit, we were quoted ₹900 for a basic pedicure but were persuaded to upgrade to spa and candle pedicures after being convinced to take membership with promises of special pricing, additional benefits, and vouchers. The rate card already showed ₹1500 and ₹2000 for members, yet later we were falsely told that a “discount” had been given. The service itself was rushed, completed in about 30 minutes with no visible difference between spa and luxury pedicure. Nail paint was skipped without consent, and when requested, we were asked to vacate the seat for another client. When we raised concerns, management admitted the service was not done properly but attempted to justify it by claiming concessions that never existed.

Despite this, the management personally requested me to remove my previous review and give them a chance to correct their mistake. Trusting them, I deleted it and visited again. This time I opted for their ₹999 facial offer. On arrival, I was informed back massage was not included (not clearly mentioned in the promotion). I agreed. I was told the facial would last 45 minutes, yet the entire service was rushed and completed in barely 25 minutes, with only 3–5 minutes of actual massage. When questioned, the response was simply “we will look into it,” with no accountability or resolution. To make it worse, the beautician mentioned that the offer is technically for new visitors only but they are “still giving it to everyone” — as if it is a favor. If that is the policy, it should be transparently stated in the promotion instead of being disclosed verbally later.

This reflects a clear pattern of misleading communication, rushed services, inconsistent pricing explanations, and poor customer handling. Running offers does not mean compromising honesty, professionalism, or value for money. Extremely disappointing experience — twice. Customers deserve transparency, respect, and the service quality they are promised.

However, later I was informed that it was not possible as per their policies, and instead of addressing the issue properly, I was offered a complementary spa session. A proper refund would have been a more appropriate resolution !!!

As a customer, when the service provided does not meet even basic expectations, simply citing policies to deny a refund does not feel justified. Policies should work both ways... not only to protect the business, but also to ensure customers receive the quality of service they are paying for. Do your rules and standards also account for situations where the service delivered is clearly below acceptable quality ?????

Many of my friends who saw the final look also pointed out how uneven and disappointing the makeup was, especially for the price charged, and some are also willing to share their feedback as well.

If you value your time, money, and how you look for an important occasion, I would strongly suggest thinking twice before choosing this salon. I would not recommend taking a chance here...never ever !!!!

Very very poor service and a highly disappointing experience 🤬😤🙌

featured_reviews.name: Rachi Nilve
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Enrich Team,

I am writing with extreme disappointment regarding the complaint I had previously raised about the reversal of my 700 Enrich points.

On Saturday, 21st February 2026, I received a call from Enrich Lokhandwala informing me that my 700 points would be credited back to my Enrich account with a lifetime validity. However, till date, I have received no confirmation, no communication, and most importantly, no credit of the said points.

When I followed up with the Lokhandwala branch, I was told that the matter is pending with the Enrich backend team. It is extremely frustrating that such a small and simple issue has been dragging on for more than 15 days without resolution.

This level of delay and lack of coordination is unacceptable. For a brand of Enrich’s stature, the customer support experience has been highly disappointing. Repeated follow-ups with no clear accountability only add to the frustration.

I expect this matter to be resolved immediately and the 700 points credited back to my account no later than this Saturday. Please treat this as urgent and provide a clear confirmation once the action has been completed.

I look forward to a prompt resolution — not another assurance.

Regards,

Rachita

I am writing to formally express my extreme dissatisfaction with the service I received at Enrich Salon (Silver Springs Lokhandwala branch) on 18th February 2026 at approximately 7:30 PM.

I had visited the salon solely for a haircut and had specifically booked an appointment under an ongoing offer. At no point during the service was I informed that a blow dry would be charged separately. Without seeking my consent or informing me of any additional charges, the stylist proceeded with a blow dry.

To my absolute shock, when I reached the billing counter, I was charged a total amount of Rs. 1701. I was informed that the blow dry had been billed separately. This is completely unacceptable. Customers have the right to be informed about additional services and their charges before they are performed. Transparency in pricing is a basic expectation.

What makes this situation even more disappointing is that there was a Rs. 999 offer available that included hair wash, haircut, and blow dry. Instead of applying this package or informing me about it, I was charged an inflated amount. In most salons, basic blow drying and setting after a haircut are not treated as a separate premium service unless clearly discussed in advance.

This experience has been extremely frustrating and unprofessional. I feel misled and overcharged. I am requesting a refund of Rs. 700 at the earliest, as the billing was unfair and done without proper communication.

I had immediately even called Enrich customer care and complained about this experience but I have not got any revert yet. Totally disappointing.

I expect a prompt resolution to this matter. Kindly treat this complaint seriously and revert at the earliest with a suitable resolution.
